ui_bugs.issue: Banner reports '56 Produkte sind am oder unter dem Mindestbestand' — because default stock_quantity and stock_min_alert are both 0 for all seed products, the condition stock_quantity <= stock_min_alert is always true. Signal is noise, not a real low-stock alert. Consider excluding rows where stock_quantity IS NULL or where both fields are 0, or require stock_min_alert > 0.

action_items: Refine low-stock banner logic in Admin.jsx (Produkte tab): count only products with stock_min_alert > 0 AND stock_quantity <= stock_min_alert; otherwise the banner is triggered by every seed product with default 0/0 values (currently 56/56 flagged).
Consider seeding stock_min_alert = 5 (or similar) on real inventory items so the banner behaves as intended.
Optional: convert TestSpecialCategories/TestSbProductCRUD class-scoped fixtures from instance methods to @classmethod (pytest 10 deprecation warning; not breaking today).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sb_upload_shipping_label: label upload + packing-slip generation + email sending happen in a single request path; 3 external I/O calls (Supabase Storage x2, Emergent mail proxy x2) and one PDF render are not wrapped in a timeout/retry. If Supabase storage is slow this endpoint will block. Consider a background task (BackgroundTasks) for the two emails.

server.py _finalize_order: invoice creation and email are wrapped in try/except (good) but the outer /api/checkout/status endpoint has no idempotency guard beyond pending.finalized – a concurrent call from success page + Stripe webhook could still race. The `select ... for update` on pending_checkouts would prevent this.
email_service.py is imported at top-level; if the Emergent email proxy is unreachable during startup import, the entire backend will crash. Verify defensive import or lazy init.
Low-stock banner condition currently uses stock_quantity <= stock_min_alert without null-check; recommend `stock_min_alert IS NOT NULL AND stock_min_alert > 0 AND stock_quantity <= stock_min_alert`.
